Secondary effluent is disposed of in a system of 37 percolation ponds with a combined area of 395 acres... The pond system is typically run in irrigation mode, where the goals are to minimize water in storage, to maximize percolative and evaporative area.

The planned expansion project will consist of a parallel treatment system utilizing membrane bioreactor (MBR) technology... The new process train will be designed to treat wastewater to meet the quality requirements... the biological process will be designed for BOD removal, nitrification and denitrification.
A new solids -handling building will be constructed to house screw presses to dewater the biological solids produced by the MBR process train.

The headworks improvements will be installed downstream of the existing headworks to split the flow between the existing oxidation ditches and the MBR process train and to provide fine screening to protect the membranes.
Chemical storage tanks and metering equipment will be provided to feed hypochlorous acid and citric acid for periodic membrane cleaning operations.
